## ✍️ MULTI-MODEL STORY PIPELINE

① xAI (Grok) — Fast scene breakdown
   grok-beta
   Splits script into raw scene beats

② OLLAMA ABLITERATE — Creative expansion
   huihui_ai/qwen2.5-abliterate:7b
   Adds emotion, tension, sensory detail

③ OLLAMA CODER — JSON structuring
   Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Uncensored
   Converts prose into strict scene JSON

④ OPENROUTER — Dialogue polish
   mistralai/mistral-large (or any model)
   Natural dialogue, pacing, transitions

⑤ GOOGLE AI STUDIO — Image prompts
   gemini-2.5-flash
   Expert ComfyUI / AnythingXL prompts

→ Your local pipeline gets the final payload

---
KEYS NEEDED:
• xAI: console.groq.com (free)
• OpenRouter: openrouter.ai
• AI Studio: aistudio.google.com
